title: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken 3rd Season
content:
For my unemployed champs, this is what a corporate Monday stand-up feels like. As another reviewer said, Tensura has already achieved what many other anime under the same umbrella set out to do, to the point it turned into a Larping versiong of itself, and for the worse too. It is the point when the series should have probably branched out under a more appropriate name. That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slack Bot.

It feels like the writers never got past the meeting phase, and just turned it into content. They might have as well rotoscoped their meeting room camera, using some digital softwaretoo, because the art was not what we’ve come to expect from this once great show.

There were undoubtedly few genuinely good episodes, but they were buried under an exhausting amount of slow paced, repetitive discussions, and characters sitting around tables explaining things to one another. So much talking, so little actually happening. Every time it seemed like the story was finally about to move forward, another committee assembled to discuss what had already happened, what might happen, and how everyone felt about the possibility of it happening.

The political and nation-building elements have always been part of the series, but previous seasons balanced them with action, exploration, comedy, and meaningful progression. Here, that balance was completely lost. World-building is not automatically interesting just because several important characters are sitting in the same room.

Season 3 was definitely the weakest so far within the Tensura franchuse.

Overall: 6.64/10.
